blocks.raw: <ExamTip>The LEA frequently presents Step 2 → Step 3 problems: "Given a slab of these dimensions and this mix design, how many bags of cement are required?" Practice these with a consistent unit discipline. Errors almost always come from unit conversion mistakes — confusing cubic meters with cubic feet, or forgetting to account for waste factors.</ExamTip>
